title: Fusion window narrower than the other menus and off-centre
detail: The Fusion Menu ends at x~1180 of 1274 while the other windows fill to ~1262; the HUD (CHOMP, crystals) shows through on the right.
fix: Fusion uses the same window frame size and position as the shared menu window.

title: Donor card still the old dark style
detail: The Compy donor card is a grey-brown block with a dark bar and red "Hatch new dinos to fuse" text inside the cream panel.
fix: Donor cards as cream copy cards like the detail page grid; the hint as dark text.

title: Result card still the old yellow block
detail: "NEW GOLD / ? / Your new dino" is a saturated yellow block with a white pill; "Guaranteed: Gold!" green outlined text.
fix: Result as a cream card with the gold tier badge (tier_gold icon) and dark text.

title: Opening another screen leaves Fusion on top
detail: With Fusion open, opening Eggs shows the Eggs window under the Fusion window (two windows stacked).
fix: Opening any shared-window screen closes the Fusion Menu first (and the other way round).
